name: Confirm the hosting package order line and hestiacp.account record
description: Should already exist from checkout - Hosting app > Accounts. If it's missing, the order may not have confirmed correctly.

name: Click Provision on the hestiacp.account record
description: Creates the real HestiaCP account on the configured server via the API. Confirm it actually completes rather than erroring silently in the chatter.

name: Click Test Connection on the HestiaCP server config
description: Only needs doing once per underlying server, not per customer - skip if already confirmed working today.

name: Confirm the customer accepted the Hosting Service Agreement
description: The Agreement Acceptance gate on the account record should show accepted before you consider this account fully live.

name: Confirm the recurring billing contract line exists
description: Check the account's linked contract has a real line and a start date - not just a shell contract with nothing on it.

name: Send the customer their hosting login details
description: HestiaCP panel URL + their login - not their Odoo portal login, a separate credential.

name: If this customer also has a domain to point at this hosting
description: Hand off to 03_domain_registration.csv for nameserver/DNS setup - don't consider hosting "done" until the domain actually resolves to it, if one was purchased.
